Fuse.js 7.1.0 is distributed unmodified as `fuse-7.1.0.min.mjs` under the Apache License 2.0. Its license is included in `FUSE-LICENSE`. Source: https://github.com/krisk/Fuse/tree/v7.1.0. Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fuse.js@7.1.0/dist/fuse.min.mjs.
